title: Delivers
body: Fresh take on habit tracking, in that it actually does just that — simply allow you to track your habits. Minimal incentive to follow some arbitrary set of rules to make habits stick, leaving it up to the user instead. Keeping it installed, looking forward to upcoming features.
author: Marthinus Brits

title: Great Tracker
body: I’ve tried a bunch of different tracking apps but none of them have nailed the simplicity and presentation of data like this one. Plus it looks and feels like an app made by Apple which goes a long way. Looking forward to the future with this one.
author: thuggyapple
